You are editing the Spring Boot backend. Read `server/AGENTS.md` before making changes — it covers
build commands, module architecture, and configuration.

Then read the module's own file: `server/module-api/AGENTS.md` for the Spring MVC contract
interfaces, or `server/module-server/AGENTS.md` for the layering rules (Controller → UseCase →
Persistence), entity/persistence patterns, and the mandatory security annotation on every use case
method.
